_comment: Mutation testing for packages/schemas, the second target after packages/core. Rationale: this package is rule #2's single validation source — every boundary in the app parses through it — and coverage here is already 100%, which is exactly the state where line coverage stops telling you anything. A weakened constraint (a `.min(1)` that becomes `.min(0)`, an enum member deleted, a `.uuid()` dropped) leaves every line covered and every test green while the boundary silently widens. It is also pure and I/O-free, so mutants are deterministic. packages/api is deliberately NOT next: it is I/O-shaped and slow to mutate. Run with `pnpm --filter @athanor/schemas mutation`.
_plugins_comment: Declared explicitly: Stryker's default plugin discovery globs node_modules and does not follow pnpm's symlinked layout, so the runner is installed and resolvable but not auto-loaded.
_thresholds_comment: `break` is the CI gate (.github/workflows/mutation.yml). Measured 95.27% (846 killed of 888) on 2026-08-21 when issue #24's vocabulary + derivation slice landed; set to 92, never aspirationally — a threshold nobody can meet becomes a red job people learn to ignore. Ratchet UP as tests land, never down (core.md precedent, same rule as the coverage floors). `low` is kept equal to `break` so a green run does not also log an 'under low threshold' warning, which is the same desensitization by another route. `high` is reporter colour only (Stryker refuses high < low) and sits at 95 so a regression off the ceiling shows yellow at once. Ratchet history: 63 → 67 when issue #182 landed (entitlements.ts, moment.ts and post-media.ts each went to 100%, 65.21% → 69.88%), 67 → 71 when the constraint cluster of issue #24 landed (69.88% → 74.04%), 71 → 92 when #24's second slice landed (73.98% → 95.27%). Note the measured chain 62.69 → 65.21 → 69.88 → 74.04 → 73.01 → 73.85 → 73.98 → 95.27 lives HERE and in CI and nowhere else — reports/mutation/ is gitignored, which is exactly how the 65.21 → 69.88 jump sat unrecorded for two commits and left the gate 7 points below reality, and how #392's 73.85 (641/868) sat while eleven later commits grew the package to 911 mutants at 73.98 with nobody re-measuring. Re-measure on a clean tree before trusting any number in this file.
_band_comment: Why ~3.3 points of slack here when packages/core runs on 0.36: the score is a ratio, so ADDING code adds to the denominator immediately and to the numerator only once tests follow. With 846 killed, `break: 92` absorbs 31 new unkilled mutants (846/919 = 92.06%) — roughly seven new enum members — before it reds. Core is near-saturated and its additions are small relative to 733 mutants; this package has a growing vocabulary, and a gate that goes red for a blameless additive change teaches people to lower it, which is the one move forbidden here. Recompute the band, do not widen it by feel: solve killed/(total+n) >= break for n.
_baseline_comment: First run scored 62.69% against 100% line coverage. That gap IS the finding: every line of this package is executed by a test and a third of its meaning is unasserted. Five tests added in the same slice took it to 65.21% by closing the three constraint holes the report exposed — a physical event with only ONE of lat/long (both existing tests nulled the pair, where `||` and `&&` agree), a link merely CONTAINING http:// rather than starting with it, and an uphold verdict WITH a severity, whose accept arm was so untested that the refine could have been a constant `false` rejecting every uphold — the report_upheld/-200 path, rule #1. Issue #182 then took entitlements.ts, moment.ts and post-media.ts to 100% each — 65.21% → 69.88%, 420 killed of 601 — by asserting the invariants those three schemas exist to protect instead of that parsing succeeded. Issue #24's constraint cluster then closed the last 18 of those — every surviving MethodExpression and Regex mutant across event.ts, help.ts, project.ts, story-segment.ts and waitlist.ts — plus the two refine tokens ('stream_url_required' / 'location_required') and their issue codes: 69.88% → 74.04%, 445 killed of 601. What that cluster taught, and what the next one copied: a nullable column tested only with null asserts nothing (project.ts terms, waitlist.ts source), a price tested only at 0 satisfies a floor and a ceiling alike, a regex tested only with a string containing no match at all never exercises its anchors, and a schema that RE-DECLARES a field rather than picking it carries its own copy of the bound — the row's assertion says nothing about the insert's. Issue #24's second slice (2026-08-21) then closed the vocabulary and derivation classes: every enum is asserted as a LITERAL list (`schema.options` against the spelled-out array, plus a rejection for a plausible non-member — never a loop over the constant, which only proves the array equals itself), every `.pick()`-derived shape as a literal `Object.keys(schema.shape)` list, the refine `path`s are pinned (the field a form keys its error off), and five re-declared vocabularies were derived instead (search.ts star → STAR_KEYS, help.ts respond → status minus 'offered', public-profile.ts milestone status, waitlist.ts locale ×2) plus two pick entries in profile.ts that `.extend()` overrode anyway — which is why the denominator FELL 911 → 888: a re-declared enum is mutable twice. realization-update.ts had no test at all (9 NoCoverage mutants) and got one; payout-ledger.ts's `reversed > amount` check was only ever exercised alongside a status flip that rejected the row on its own. 73.98% → 95.27%, 846 killed of 888. What remains, and why it is the ceiling rather than a backlog: 36 Zod message strings (rule #5 — user-facing copy lives in @athanor/i18n and Zod's own text reaches no user; profile.ts:24's refine-options object is message-only, 37 in all), and 5 mutants the vitest runner cannot observe — a mutation that makes the module throw at import (`z.object({})` on a schema a later line reads `.shape.field` from in profile.ts and realization-plan.ts; the discriminatedUnion options and discriminator in circle.ts) yields a test file with zero collected tests and no failing test, which @stryker-mutator/vitest-runner 9.6.1 reports as Survived with testsCompleted 0 rather than as an error. Those 42 put the ceiling near 95.3%, not 100%: a score above it means the denominator moved, not that the messages were asserted.
